title: Skupash Creek (Jamaica Meadows)
summary: A Jamaica Meadows creek name recorded in a 1657 division of meadow lots.
introduction_content: Skupash is recorded as a creek in the Jamaica Meadows of Queens County.
history_content: A 1657 division of Jamaica Meadows describes meadow lots in relation to a creek and river called Skupash. The older meadow landscape is associated broadly with Jamaica Bay and Jamaica Meadows but cannot be reduced to one exact modern point.
translation_content:
Skupash may be a contraction of a word meaning grass, grassy, or meadow.

Why Place Names Matter

“Names and stories, places and trails, history, and culture are closely connected.”

— Alestine Andre, Ingrid Kritsch, Kristi Benson, and Sharon Snowshoe, An Indigenous Place Names Handbook: Sharing the Gwich'in Experience in Canada (2023), PDF page 19

Place-name history should show Native people as active and present, not only as names in old documents.
preservation_content: Skupash keeps attention on the wet meadow and creek geography of Jamaica Bay, where colonial meadow divisions preserved Native place-name forms.
